book.name: Makna Yesusmoa.
book.title: Makna Yesusmoa. Yesusva Nengthal Lohv, Sesoana Moalamangva Kuvuwulluhv.

content: Yesus Tihsongom Wolapho Vena Daikakamungilna Nihmerini.
Doa Yesustatanamba nohalm pulvo, Gerasanindna pethara di pulvona.
Wo botrini wonholopenamba engalla, wo mongova indhanariniva phona. No indhanariniva tihsongomungilva, wo noinda dai omana vevna,
wo indhanahuira limana vevna pokamahulsra. Dai omana vevna, wo indhanamba eva es kekel vivta, owai.
Wenamba englamonglava indhanamba henamba ningewol velvohmanavna, heva os owai. Indhanamba indkumbim eva pingokoho vaomana vevnata, wemba nomba himba bilvhanga vaomana vevna.
Wo okombanam sinim di pokamahulsra eva olora weingona lohmana ovovna, hevm honsra pusungu vevna aiv.
Wo himba Yesusm nonglanga venamba, Yesusva ten botra prov, wo Yesus holopenamba, doa daikakamungil lelnam promnanamba, mulumbdandna lohvhoamna Yesusinda murapeta,
doa Yesusm mindnam omnana, Yesus, yimba Sesoa mendeklina ombol, es ata yimba kamba venavav? Sesoana novra men kava yem ishomnav, manam yimba kamba ata nihsesowolm venavav.

Doa Yesus tihm omnana, tihva nomba no daikakamungilna nihmera avna, omnana pevm sevro nihilm. Wo tih una, Mindnam, manara kava mindnam aevv. Doa Yesus tihm unna, yimba sahoklal vilov, nihmerini pulvo.
Doa daikakamungilva Yesusm mindnam ishomnana, tihva honamba manam yimba oklava wolanga vevav kanaminiva, owai.
Wo monglava deuvmotovpa mura di olopethalla ki hlalvohvna,
wo Yesus no tihm wolanga velm vevna, tihva wenamona una, kamoa wolanga veo, nom deuvmotovm mera saivoe,

doa Yesus unna, wouta. Doa tihva indhanarinimini pulvonamba, nom deuvmotovra sihangu vena, doa noinda no deuvmotovpa olora vitivhoalla, lomosis peivvna plombram, wo wusprowol venamba, wohdalna. Nomba deuvmotovpa eva notongopetamma, 2000pelara lovahvna.
Doa nomba indhanamba miemba dahwol vinamba, nomba lelnam gapiana, deuvkembelnindm ishulanginna, deuvnindm monanindm. Wo indkumbi nonglalm embanamba, es hevpa vine.
Doa Yesusm nonglapulvona, wo indhanarinim nom nunglina, ten doara dai omana vevnam, wo malona beswonam av, beswonam men nengavnang vawov. Doa noinda indkumbi nunglivnamba, pem vinivna Yesusnapenam.

Wo nomba indhanamba doara miemba dahwol vewuvnamba, noi osva no kembelnindmba ishunna, Yesusva os vini. Yesus daikakamungilmba wolaihaphona, wo tihsongova henaminiva meinda sihapieinnamba, noinda miemba nomba dalna.
Doa noinda no indhana Yesusm opholihina, ai kanaminioa geinu.
Doa Yesusva nomini botra vongo, wo no indhanarini mura pronamba, ten doara Yesusva selvhoapipahamnanam. Hev ona, Yesus, pioa engai, yei kava mongawulm ahamana velm vev.
Doa Yesus omnana, owai, deuvram gao, sehpevm os ishongeinu, Sesoava kamba wavra vovhoamni, wo noinda kanamba selvhoapipahai, wo kava beswonam lohv daipotava.

Doa himba noinda os vena, ganamba, mongona kembella mongona kembella di Dekapolisnahalm, wo nom ishungeinna, Yesusva kamba doa sishona vrena. Wo nomba indhanamba hillivnamba, os uvna, pai, es hevpa vevna.
Yesusva Nengthal Lohvna, Osm Uvavulmungilm, Indhanamindilm Wolapho Velm.
Doa Yesustatana nomini botra wongavna, henga mongnahalm wonpho, wo Yesus botrini petharam holopenamba, engalla lohvna, wo indhana mindnam di Yesusinda kusoprana.
Wo mongo tendorini pronamba, no tendoriniva mendekli lohvna Yutanindna sembayangnindna, nihilva Yairus. Pronamba, Yesusm pethara lithamnavna novlomossis,
osm vevna, Yesusm mindnam osahmanavna, omnana, momba kanamba doa indnakra vev. Pro, engla holothomno, ata noinda uvavulva wuleihavav, wo ata beswonam avav. Tahonmba henamba 12pelara lohmanana.
Wo Yesusva pethamna, wo ombandhanamba mindnam eva mongawulm gapiavna, mi sis nihanasis sihanasis.
Wo Yesusi Yairusi mendah monam engavna, mongova ungevlirini mura provna, nomba ungevlirinimba wosepul kovhoavna, tahonmba 12pelara vena.
Wo no ungevliriniva diva doarava aiwo vohavna obatrava mantrimba, esvemawus esvema tahon himba dembrahowovna obatramba, heva os demutrava wuleihavnamoa, ambo nihva hevnamba aiv wohgavna.

Wo no ungevliriniva doara hellenamba, Yesusva os andra vev, doa nengvna, ambo ata eva kava Yesusna malom tuhrava, wo kamba kanandhavav. Wo Yesusva mendah monam gavna, ombandhanamba pelkleihamnavna, doa no ungevliriniva sis pethamna, Yesusna malom tuhmana englana,
wo tovolva wohkik vena, wo hevm nonglana, kamba doa kanandhai.
Doa Yesusva nungi lilnam os nengvna, an kana meississongolpetava kenga vrei, wo meissis umharavhoa, ona, an kanamba malova tuhi?
Wo hevtindi umnina, snallava esm yimba owol vev? Pev nongalo, indhanamba mindnam maim ambo alalapat vev.
Wo Yesusva mendah ona novvungu vena, an kamba tuhi?
Wo ungevliriniva nomba pem eisungu vevna, wo Yesusinda muram prona, mulumbdandna lohvhoa, doa Yesusm moakus omana, kamba wosepul kovhoaomana vevnamba, noinda yemba kava tuhi.
Wo Yesus omnana, yimba os nengi, Yesus kanamba ata selvhoapipahavav, wo noinda yimba kamba tuhi, wo noinda yimba beswonam av. Doa beswonam gao, doa yenamba kik vei tovolva.
Yesus mendah no ungevlirinim ishomnavna, wo monglava indhana Yairusna deuvrini ambanamba, Yairusm umnina, doa mopevmba dahai, manam yimba ombamba Yesusm waiprovav.
Doa Yesusva hena moamba hillinna, doa Yairusm omnana, manam yimba duus vevav honindava, ambo kam keknam nengmanavm. Ata kava yemba beswonam vemnavav.
Wo Yesus ongowolna, manam indkumbiva yimba prapiavav, Pita Yems Yon yengas ambo. Yemsi Yoni etel boasalal.
Wo wonganamba, Yairusna deuvra wonpho. Doa Yesus os nongalna, indhana mindnam di wuo ovna.
Wo deuvra siha, os unna, manam hevpa yimba wuo ov? Momba honamba dahaimoa, ambo dawonam ninliv.

Himba olhmona ishunvna, wo no indhana los umnina, gekala ov, doa wohdahai, ata hengava snamba es phovav? Wo Yesus nomba indhanamba engalungu ve, unna, phopiao. Wo araravalm Yemsm Yonm Pitam honamangas hevho wonsiha no deuvrava, otolm ten vindilvnam.
Doa Yesus nom otolmindilm englaval okivra, hevna moana omnana, talita kum, osm omnavna, mo pho.
Doa no mutundisrinimba mindilva henga phona, beswonam lohmana vena. Doa no indhanamba deuvmera di nunglutithueivnamba, os uvna, pai, pai, es hevpa vei?
Wo Yesus araravalm unna, inne endaho, wo manam yimba ishuvmona vinvav indhanamba, osva Yesusva os vena, aembu.
